# Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2004

**Amending Section III of Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 1999**

## Summary

This ordinance amends Section III of [[MO-01-S1999]], regulating the use of videoke machines in Pitogo, Quezon. It specifies that only individuals aged eighteen (18) years and above are allowed to use videoke, sets the operating hours from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and limits the duration of use to a maximum of ten (10) days.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section I.** Amends Section III of [[MO-01-S1999]] as follows:
    *   Only individuals aged eighteen (18) years and above are allowed to use videoke.
    *   The use of videoke is permitted from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
    *   The use of videoke is limited to a maximum of ten (10) days.
